payload.friendly_name: Operating-model templates and a Role kind
payload.purpose_context: About half of the EU SCC technical-and-organisational-measure headings describe an operating model (governance, accountability, incident handling, supplier management). DocKitty can stub a page today but gives no body template and has no kind for an accountable role. This mission adds an opt-in operating-model section preset, structure-and-prompt templates in the stub tools, and a Role kind, so consumers can document their operating model and classify it against the measures catalog.
payload.purpose_tldr: Give teams ready page templates for documenting how their organisation runs, plus a Role page kind for accountable functions.
